title: PolyMods
description: Pack that focuses on giving better experience while playing minecraft without drastic changes like a lot of new blocks, dimensions, machines etc.
body:
PolyMods focuses on giving better experience while playing minecraft without drastic changes like a lot of new blocks, dimensions, machines etc. 

It adds new biomes (made out of vanilla blocks), some building blocks like roofs bridges etc. some new structures, and optimization mods
